annotations.title: Compare two to four nursing homes

description: The tool compares two to four nursing homes by their six-character CCNs. It returns the same fields for each home side by side: Medicare's star ratings, nurse staffing hours per resident per day, staff turnover, the latest inspection summary, and fines as CMS publishes them. A missing value stays null. OpenHealth adds no grade and does not rank the homes.

ccns.description: Two to four six-character CMS Certification Numbers (CCNs).

name: compare_nursing_homes
